transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I came in because I feel worn out almost every day. Even when I get a full night’s sleep, I wake up feeling like my body and head are still dragging, especially when I’m getting ready for my cashier shift.
Alongside feeling worn out, have you been experiencing persistent low or depressed mood?
I’m not really sure I’d call it depressed. I haven’t especially noticed a low mood.
Has anyone ever told you that you snore loudly when you sleep?
I’m not sure. No one’s mentioned that to me, at least not that I remember.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about everyday matters, or feeling anxious most of the time?
Yeah, I do. My mind is always jumping from one thing to another—money, the relative staying with us, my wife being stressed, church stuff, and whether I’m messing up at work.
How long have you been dealing with this constant worry?
About a year and three months, I’d say. It really started around when our older relative moved in with us.
Do you find it difficult to control or stop these worries once they get started?
Yeah. I try to tell myself to pray on it or just leave it alone, but once it starts, it sort of rolls into the next worry. Then I’m thinking through every bad way the day could go.
Have you noticed any physical tension in your body, like tight, stiff, or aching muscles?
I haven’t really noticed my muscles feeling tight or aching, no.
Do you often find yourself feeling restless, keyed up, or on edge?
I’m not really sure what you mean by keyed up. I haven’t noticed myself being especially restless, though.
Have you found yourself feeling unusually irritable, short-tempered, or easily annoyed with others?
No, I don’t think I’ve been more short-tempered than usual. I haven’t really noticed getting easily annoyed with people.
Have you had trouble concentrating, or felt like your mind goes blank?
Yeah, sometimes at the register I’ll be looking right at the screen but my mind’s on stuff at home or bills. Then I lose track and have to recount the drawer or catch a small mistake.
Have you had trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or finding your sleep restless?

Most nights, yeah. I’m tired when I get into bed, but then I’m lying there thinking about bills, my work schedule, whether everybody at home is okay. And even when I do sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really settled down.
